acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Void Horrors family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Fracture, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Wrong-Fold Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Wrong-folding body with orbiting clusters of eyes and a star-flecked interior visible through fractured gaps.
Signature mechanic: Contradictory Fold: orbiting eyes mark two apparent hinges while the star-flecked interior opens at a third gap and folds the body through that route.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a geometry controller that folds the arena route differently from its orbiting eye cluster.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 faceless thin limbs, missing edge, and no reflection gain one external mineral clamp; T2 the face-hole rim gains a sediment load key; T3 the eye orbit and star interior gain fracture gauges; T4 the partial contour and negative limb gain bounded boundary braces; T5 the eye-ring and unresolved absence gain one external load interval.

Motion/process branches: T1 the thin-limb missing edge briefly loads its external clamp without filling the absence; T2 the face-hole rim commits one load key; T3 eye-orbit pauses transfer star-interior load; T4 the partial negative limb loads and releases one brace; T5 the unresolved eye-ring loads and fractures one interval.
counterplay: Take the eye-less star gap and strike the exposed geometric hinge after the fold. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the faceless thin-limb missing edge with no reflection exposes its external clamp fault after load; T2 the face-hole rim exposes its fractured key after commitment; T3 the eye orbit and star interior expose the load-gauge fault between transfers; T4 the partial negative limb exposes the bounded brace after release; T5 the unresolved eye-ring exposes its fracture interval after load.
identityInvariants: Rough humanoid or many-limbed absence retains edges that fail to close while proportions shift only within readable tier silhouettes.
Matte void black, negative space, purple-black, star flecks, and one bounded cold eye accent remain source grammar rather than affinity evidence.
Absence, non-reflection, star-field interior, fractured geometry, eye rings, and geometric shards never resolve into ordinary flesh or matter.
Power subtracts coherence: later forms occupy less resolvable physical presence while telegraph anchors become deliberately sparse.
telegraph: The body bends the wrong way, the eye cluster pauses, and one star-field gap widens without an eye above it.
